name: lens
title: Lens
description: A lens that magnifies whatever is under the pointer, or sits at a fixed position.

props.name: children
props.description: The content to magnify. It is rendered twice (once magnified), so keep it presentational.

props.name: zoomFactor
props.description: Magnification inside the lens. Must be at least 1.

props.name: lensSize
props.description: Diameter of the lens in pixels.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the lens sits when isStatic is set, relative to the container.

props.name: defaultPosition
props.description: Where the lens rests while the pointer is outside; the lens is then always visible.

props.name: isStatic
props.description: Keep the lens at position instead of following the pointer.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the lens takes to appear and disappear.

props.name: lensColor
props.description: Colour of the mask that shapes the lens.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the focusable zoom region. Escape hides the lens.
